answer: A juror that skips cases loses 25% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. Because the atlas decay is applied at each close, the ocean audit publishes the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool therefore watches its influence decay while paying the oasis fee to keep them eligible. Honest users pay that once, farms 10 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
